sections.title: Who Am I?
text: Hi, my name is Arturo. I live in a small Mexico with my partner and two small cats.

image.text: My cats, Marie and Pascal, a couple of months ago

text: I love computer science, reading and playing videogames. I also have a couple other hobbies: baking bread, rollerblading and studying Japanese, plus I try to stay fit by swimming and running.

sections.title: Why does this site exist?
text: I made this site to express whatever thoughts occur to me in a way in which they leave a footprint that is harder to erase than the short timespan in which they may live in my brain.

Some of the posts in here hopefully will be something that is worth remembering, while most of them will be forgotten way easier than they were written, but that is fine. As long as I have a place to write wathever I find interesting, It is good.

sections.title: What will you find in this site?
text: Mostly whatever I find interesting at the moment, but the most recurring themes would be:
list: And a thing or two about what I experience in life

text: This page is lighthearted, so there should be no expectation for there to be sensitive or highly debatable topics. In another vein, you may find some posts in spanish, depending on how I feel I should write that day (and because I hope to be a more compelling wirter in my native tongue).
Finally, as a strict rule, everything here is handwritten (or hand-typed, I guess) and thought of by me.
